answers.reason: Deans are faculty leaders and do not form part of the central university leadership that exclusively runs the senate.
Budget planning affects the university-wide plan where higher-ranking groups and leadership are involved, allowing a dean to participate.
Professorship appointments affect the university-wide plan and involve higher-ranking groups, permitting a dean to take part.
A dean leads one faculty and participates directly in the affairs and council of that faculty.
Examination matters of individual students are handled by specific boards rather than faculty leadership.
